CustomField.description: Prompt tokens served from the provider's cache, which bill at roughly a tenth of full rate. The artifact-first prefix reorder exists to make this number large, so it is the number that says whether it is working. Written by: Receipt, summed from the provider's own usage block. Read by: nobody in the pass - TELEMETRY IS OBSERVATION AND NO BRANCH MAY READ IT, so a number that is wrong can never be a run that is wrong.
CustomField.label: Cache Read Tokens
